name: The Memory Coast
premise: Lighthouse light guides lost memories home in a coastal fantasy world.
eraSetting: A coastal society using brass machinery and lenses.
coreRules: Lost memories may be recovered, but choices have consequences.
technologyMagicLimits: Memories cannot be freely created or duplicated. Recovery consumes stored light.
societyKeyPlaces: Keepers maintain the beacons. Key places: a cliffside lighthouse, fishing village and old stone harbor.
forbiddenContradictions: No unexplained modern computers, unlimited magic or recovery without a cost.
